The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TECHNICAL CONDITIONS (ATC) Name of Work: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of Enterprise Router and Desk top Computers 1. Scope of Supply Supply, installation, configuration, testing and commissioning of the following equipment with all necessar y accessories and software licences: Sl. No. Item Quantity 1 Desktop Computer 02 Nos. 2 Router 01 No.

2. Technical Specifications A. Router Minimum 08 Gigabit Ethernet LAN ports. Support for IPv4, IPv6, static and dynamic routing. Configuration for connectivity with the existing KSWAN network. Complete with power supply, rack mounting kit, accessories and required licences. Suitable for 230 V AC, 50 Hz supply through the supplied adapter. B. Desktop Computers Component Specification Processor Intel Core i7 RAM 16 GB DDR4 Storage 512 GB SSD Display 27-inch Full HD Operating System Genuine Windows 11 Office Software Genuine Microsoft Office 2024 Accessories Keyboard, mouse and necessary power cables 3. Software Licences Router subscription licences shall be valid for at least 12 months from commissioning. 5. Warranty The router shall carry a minimum one-year comprehensive warranty from commissioning. The warranty period for desktop computers shall be clearly mentioned in the bid. Warranty certificates and service contact details shall be provided. 6. Eligibility Criteria 1. The bidder shall have supplied similar networking equipment or minimum 02 computers during the l ast one years. 2. The bidder shall have a local service centre within 50 km of the installation site for repair and servici ng. Address proof and contact details shall be submitted with the bid. 3. The bidder shall be ISO 9001 certified and shall submit a valid certificate. 4. The bidder shall submit copies of: GST Registration Certificate. PAN Card. Authorisation Certificate, if applicable. Similar Work Orders / Completion Certificates. Proof of the local service centre. 5. Bidder should attach non black listed affidavit in past 5 years. 7. Delivery Period The entire work shall be completed within 90 days from the date of the Purchase Order. 9. General Conditions

All equipment shall be new and genuine. Prices shall include supply, transportation, accessories, installatio n, testing, commissioning and training. Applicable taxes shall be shown separately. . 3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods
